title: People queue, round 4
instructions:
People in a crowded frame. The note says how many on-court players or referees have no box yet, and which boxes are flagged as covering two people.
No box: press 1 (player) or 6 (referee), then ⇧-drag a tight box. A flagged box on two people: drag its edges onto one of them (or select it and X to delete it), then ⇧-drag a box for the other. ⌥-drag moves a selected box.
Enter: frame done, next · [ ] previous / next frame · U undo · scroll to zoom, F fit. A frame you cannot fix: leave it with ]; it stays out of training.
